sources.title: Mnemo — Persistent Engineering Cognition for AI Agents
sources.snippet: Your AI coding agent forgets everything between sessions. Mnemo gives it a persistent memory layer — knowledge graphs, semantic recall, and cross-session context that never fades.

sources.title: Mnemo — Your AI finally knows you.
sources.snippet: Private, local memory for Claude · a demonstration Your AI finally knows you. Every Claude conversation starts from zero. Mnemo was built to fix that — a standing memory Claude reads before each session, kept in a private library only your machine holds the key to. This site is now its demonstration room.

sources.snippet: Mnemo gives AI agents persistent, structured memory — recall, learn, and share knowledge across sessions. 82.1% on LoCoMo, first in multi-hop reasoning.
